verdict.rationale: Column documents a dedicated API sandbox in which every route is sandboxed and data persists like production [column-docs-13]. Simulation endpoints for incoming wires and ACH let you set balances and drive test scenarios [column-docs-3]. Mode-locked API keys keep sandbox access isolated from live mode [column-docs-20], and community feedback confirms a separate Sandbox environment exists on the status page [column-comm-6]. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of sandbox fidelity and isolation in practice.
